C1821.title: Yueqing, Wenzhou: Cash-on-Delivery Scam Impersonating Luxury Store, 810,000+ Blind-Shipped Parcels
C1821.summary: From May 2020, Zhang and Feng plotted to ship unsolicited parcels to random recipients on a cash-on-delivery basis to pocket payment. Abusing his role as an express delivery station manager, Feng illegally downloaded over 810,000 pieces of citizen personal data, fabricated the sender as a luxury flagship store in Hangzhou, and blind-shipped low-quality belts and bangles costing 3-10 yuan each at COD prices of 98-198 yuan, dispatching over 810,000 parcels in six months. In August 2022, the Yueqing City Procuratorate in Wenzhou prosecuted the case; the second-instance judgment sentenced Zhang and Feng to 12.5 and 11 years respectively for fraud and infringing on citizens' personal information, while Wang and Chen received 3 and 2.5 years for fraud.
